meta.title: A Dynamic Knowledge Update-Driven Model with Large Language Models for Fake News Detection
meta.paper_type_explanation: The paper introduces DYNAMO, a novel system combining LLMs and dynamic knowledge graphs for fake news detection with continuous updates.

A_data_and_task.domain_data_type_explanation: Focuses on news events from social media and internet sources requiring timely updates due to evolving authenticity.
A_data_and_task.task_type_explanation: Primary task is binary classification of news as Real or Fake, using multi-hop reasoning and knowledge verification.

dataset_size.documents: Hover: 18,171 samples; Feverous: 26,928 samples (filtered to sentence evidence)

A_data_and_task.dataset_characteristics_explanation: Datasets consist of multi-hop factual statements from Wikipedia; Hover has 18,171 samples, Feverous 26,928 (using natural language sentence evidence). Subsets used to test dynamic updates on similar events.
A_data_and_task.benchmark_metrics_explanation: DYNAMO achieves top results: Hover (Acc 0.6250, F1 0.7401, P 0.7367, R 0.7436); Feverous (Acc 0.6167, F1 0.7433, P 0.7384, R 0.7483).

B_graph_kg_structure.graph_kg_representation_type_explanation: News-domain-specific KG with entities E, relations R, triples S; built via LLM entity/relation extraction, enhanced dynamically. Not explicitly temporal.
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_evolution_type_explanation: Dynamic updates append new triples from verified real news texts and reasoning paths to existing KG.
B_graph_kg_structure.node_types_explanation: Nodes are entities extracted from reliable news texts; events handled via subject-predicate-object triples.
B_graph_kg_structure.edge_types_explanation: Relations extracted generatively by LLM (entity-centered and event-centered), e.g., 'father', 'job', 'superior'.
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_schema_explanation: No fixed ontology mentioned; relations generated dynamically via LLM prompting.
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_scale_explanation: Scale not quantified; built from reliable news sources, subgraphs retrieved (top-K=5 triples).

C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_structure_type_explanation: No explicit temporal KG or event-centric modeling; focuses on news timeliness via dynamic updates, not structured time.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_representation_explanation: N/A; mentions events' suddenness/unstability but no formal temporal reps.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_conflict_redundancy_handling_ex: No temporal conflicts; updates only from verified real news.
C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.multi_hop_temporal_reasoning_explanation: Multi-hop via MCTS paths and KG subgraphs, but no temporal aspects.

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_trigger_explanation: Triggered after fake news detection: for verified real news, extract/update triples.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_policy_control_logic_explanation: Only update from news detected as REAL via MCTS majority voting.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_scope_explanation: New triples (entities, relations) extracted from news text + reasoning paths.

verification_pipeline.confidence_scoring_approach: Majority voting on MCTS leaf nodes

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.verification_pipeline_explanation: MCTS decomposes news into sub-questions, answers with KG/internal knowledge, detects via majority.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.conflict_resolution_strategy_explanation: No explicit conflicts; assumes verified real news is reliable.

incremental_construction.entity_linking_method: LLM entity extraction + matching to KG

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.incremental_construction_explanation: Extract entities, generate relations/triples via LLM, append to G.

E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_unit_granularity_explanation: Top-K (5) triples from 1-hop KG subgraph matching sub-question entities.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_strategy_explanation: Entity matching -> 1-hop subgraph -> LLM ranks/selects top-K triples.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.reasoning_generation_protocol_explanatio: MCTS generates reasoning paths: sub-question gen/answer/detect; majority voting.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.multi_hop_reasoning_support_explanation: MCTS explores paths up to depth h; UCT selection with majority-based rewards.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.context_window_management_explanation: Limit to top-5 relevant triples to fit LLM input.

F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_role_in_system_explanation: LLM builds initial KG, performs MCTS reasoning/detection, extracts new triples.
F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_adaptation_mode_explanation: Phi3-mini-128k with few-shot (3 samples); no fine-tuning beyond setup.
F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_integration_pattern_explanation: Generative extraction (entity-centered, event-centered); reasoning guided by prompts/actions.
F_llm_role_and_learning.prompt_engineering_explanation: Few-shot (3); CoT via MCTS steps; specific for actions A1-A3, triple extraction/ranking.
F_llm_role_and_learning.continual_learning_support_explanation: N/A; uses external KG updates instead.

G_evaluation_and_practical.evaluation_focus_explanation: Fake news accuracy; dynamic KG update gains (~1% acc); ablation on components/LLMs.
G_evaluation_and_practical.evaluation_metrics_explanation: SOTA on Hover/Feverous; KG updates improve acc by avg 1%; robust to h param.

performance_gains: DYNAMO outperforms all baselines across Acc/F1/P/R

G_evaluation_and_practical.baseline_comparisons_explanation: Beats traditional/LLM baselines; e.g., Hover Acc 62.50% vs Phi3-mini 58.50%. Gains from MCTS+KG.
G_evaluation_and_practical.graph_summarization_compression_explanat: Top-K triple selection as subgraph summary.
G_evaluation_and_practical.explainability_explanation: MCTS paths provide step-by-step reasoning/sub-Q answers.
G_evaluation_and_practical.scalability_analysis_explanation: Robust to MCTS depth h; optimal h=5/9 per dataset. No large-scale tests.

H_novel_technical_contributions.algorithmic_innovations_explanation: MCTS with 3 actions (sub-Q gen/answer/detect), UCT rewards via majority consistency.
H_novel_technical_contributions.architecture_patterns_explanation: KG-LLM loop: construct -> retrieve/enhance MCTS -> update from real news.
H_novel_technical_contributions.memory_storage_explanation: KG as persistent external memory; updated incrementally.
H_novel_technical_contributions.neural_architecture_explanation: No GNNs; LLM-centric with KG retrieval.

implementation_details.hardware_requirements: NVIDIA A40 48GB GPU, Intel Xeon Gold 6326 CPU

I_reproducibility_implementation.implementation_details_explanation: PyTorch 2.5.0; Phi3-mini-128k; MCTS n=5, top-K=5, c=2.
I_reproducibility_implementation.hyperparameters_explanation: h sensitivity tested; optimal per dataset.

J_limitations_future_work.acknowledged_limitations_explanation: Fake news may mix true/false info; current method extracts only from full real news.

suggested_improvements: Distinguish true/false parts in fake news for partial updates

J_limitations_future_work.future_research_directions_explanation: Fine-grained knowledge from fake news' true parts to maximize utilization.

provenance_trust.source_tracking: Reliable news sources for initial KG

K_cross_cutting_concerns.provenance_trust_explanation: Initial KG from reliable sources; updates only from detected real news.
K_cross_cutting_concerns.domain_adaptation_explanation: News-specific KG; works across LLMs (Phi3, LLaMA, Flan-T5).

key_innovations: Dynamic KG updates verified via fake news detection
MCTS for news decomposition + KG enhancement
unique_approaches: Dual LLM roles: detect + extract/verify new knowledge
main_findings: SOTA performance; ~1% acc gain from updates; robust across LLMs

notable_contributions_explanation: Addresses timeliness in fake news via KG updates from verified news; MCTS uncovers semantics. Related: DALK, PEG (KG+LLM but no dynamic updates).

ambiguous_classifications: Temporal aspects: static KG despite dynamic news
extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Paper aligns partially with GraphRAG/dynamic KG via updatable KG+LLM for news; lacks explicit temporality. Quantitative results extracted from tables.
